Description: The Localizer is a utility class that stores localized bundles, resolves the active localization from the current language, listens to global application configuration changes, and emits an event when the language changes.

localizations.description: A record of language codes mapped to localization bundles. Keys are language codes; values are localization bundles or undefined. Supplied once through the constructor and internally owned thereafter.

language.description: The active language used to resolve the current lexicon. The constructor initializes this value from the normalized browser language or from the normalized constructor argument (`en-US` becomes `en`). Later assignments through `language` or `setLanguage()` are stored verbatim. Falsy assignments are ignored; non-string assignments throw `Invalid language value: <value>`. Setting the same value does not emit an event.
language.default: <navigator.language normalized to base lowercase language code>

lexicon.description: The resolved localization bundle for the current language. Resolution order: the bundle matching `language`, then the English bundle `en`, then the first available bundle. Throws `Localizer: no localization bundles are available.` when none exists.

initialized.description: Indicates whether the Localizer is listening for global application configuration changes on `window`. Set by `initialize()`, cleared by `dispose()`.

initialize.description: Registers the Localizer to listen for global application configuration changes on `window`. Idempotent: calling it while already initialized has no effect.

dispose.description: Removes the global application configuration listener previously registered by `initialize()`. Idempotent: calling it while not initialized has no effect.

setLanguage.description: Updates the active language by delegating to the `language` setter.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: The new language value to store. Falsy values are ignored.

onlanguagechange.description: Triggered when the active language changes to a new truthy value. Not triggered when the assigned language is falsy or equals the current language.

onappconfigchange.description: A window-level custom event used to synchronize the Localizer with application configuration changes.
